name: Binance Account Compromise
technique: Hot wallet key compromise; Operational security lapse
rootCause: On or around November 11, 2023, a hot wallet linked to the Binance deployer on Ethereum was compromised, resulting in the theft of approximately $27 million USDT. The funds were quickly converted to ETH, routed through mixing services, and bridged to Bitcoin via THORChain, making recovery difficult. The compromise stemmed from operational exposure of a hot wallet private key. The exact method of compromise (phishing, malware, endpoint theft, or mismanagement) is not publicly disclosed. The incident was not caused by a Binance platform vulnerability, but by control loss over a user- or affiliate-operated wallet.
